## Title 👆

⚠️ Make sure your PR title follows this format:

- [ ] Prefix (according to [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0-beta.2/): feat, fix, hotfix, chore, refactor, revert, docs, style, test)
- [ ] Issue number (e.g. RSS-ECOMM-1_01, where 1 is the sprint number and 01 is the issue number)
- [ ] Short description of the change

**Example:**
`feat(RSS-ECOMM-1_01): add product filter dropdown`

## Description 👇

#### Changes Overview

- Add description of your changes here 🫵
- ...

#### Changes Rationale

_Explain the context behind the changes if needed_

#### Related issue(s)

- Closes #123
- ...

## Self-check 👌

Before requesting a review, please confirm the following:

- [ ] PR title follows the specified format
- [ ] A meaningful description is added
- [ ] All related issues numbers are referenced (`Closes #`)
- [ ] The related issue is moved to the **In Review** column on the project board
- [ ] The PR is clear and I'm ready to merge 🤌
